The confirmed gross separation (+88bp event-level at 433 rows) sits BELOW the two-leg cost bar, which is precisely why nobody monetizes it naively; the re-read asks whether magnitude at 655 rows clears the frozen 100bp/45bp bars before any sleeve is built. This read allocates no capital and changes no order.
candidates.falsifier: Pair-sleeve build does NOT qualify unless BOTH frozen viability bars pass on the frozen cohort: (V1) event-level separation (mean of per-event mean excess_10d, negative minus positive) > 100bp; (V2) row-level pooled mean separation > 45bp. Additionally the five exp-20260807-001 confirmation bars are re-verified for direction stability: floors (negative rows >= 200, events >= 20, dates >= 10, positive rows >= 200); event-level negative > positive; row-level mean AND median negative > positive; separation positive in both chronological halves; no single negative event > 40% of summed positive per-event excess and no single ticker > 40% of row-level positive excess mass. Any V-bar fail re-parks the lane at the next +50%/+10 bar (>= 983 closed negative rows) with the builder synced in the same ticket AFTER close; a confirmation-bar fail additionally kills the separation claim itself and must be recorded as direction instability. The tilt shape is already dead outcome-blind (1/0/0 executed-entry touches vs >= 5 per window, structurally uncovered windows); no touch bar is re-read here.
